set.st: Robbers of the Grass Lake bank fled to a hotel off Wolf Lake Road; police recovered most of the loot, but about $1,300 in gold and silver was never found. A Jackson paper a week later said the evidence pointed to someone picking the money up at the lakeside cottage during the gunfight, so a roadside cache is doubtful. Pin is Wolf Lake (the 1920 gunfight at the Mack Island cottage), not the spot itself.
set.pl: Mack Island cottage, Wolf Lake (gang cornered here 1920); island not yet located.
pinev: Lake-level: GNIS Wolf Lake, Jackson Co; the 1920 sources put the gunfight and the probable loss of the $1,300 at the Mack Island cottage on Wolf Lake. Mack Island is not in GNIS (about 1.2 km).
